objective: measure which public TotalSegmentator anatomy labels are present and useful in the fixed ReXGroundingCT val200 cohort before implementing VoxTell anatomy fusion

external_dependency.runtime_policy: install pinned TotalSegmentator with --no-deps so the host-compatible CUDA 12.6 PyTorch build is preserved

inputs.ct_input_contract: original HU-valued CT in source LPS geometry

storage.cache_format: one native-geometry uint8 multilabel NIfTI plus JSON metadata per case

phase_a_val200_inventory.output_geometry: upsampled to original CT shape and affine
phase_a_val200_inventory.resume_policy: skip complete cases; use per-case locks and atomic completion markers

phase_b_quality_check.comparison: 1.5 mm total ROI subset versus 3 mm phase-A masks
phase_b_quality_check.selection: thoracic labels retained after label-frequency and target-overlap audit
phase_b_quality_check.purpose: choose the final high-resolution anatomy ontology and cache recipe

selection_rule: retain labels only when they provide thoracic location, side, lobe, airway, pleural-adjacent, mediastinal, or chest-wall context; merge repetitive ribs and vertebrae into grouped channels
